Container.Name: Lodestar-gluetun
Container.Overview: Lodestar crawls the BitTorrent DHT, fetches torrent metadata from peers and makes it searchable. It keeps names, file lists, sizes, dates and swarm counts in one local index. Open the web UI after the first start. The setup token appears in the container log. Enter it to create the admin password. This variant sends all traffic through your gluetun container, so the DHT and peer traffic leave through the VPN and never from your own address. Publish the web UI port on the gluetun container, not here. The VPN container must be named gluetun; if yours has another name, change it in the Network setting (Extra Parameters: --network=container:NAME). The [IP] WebUI link may not resolve with container networking, so open the web UI at your server address and the port published on gluetun. Inbound DHT reach needs a port your VPN provider forwards (see the notes in docs/operations.md).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Index, database and settings. Use a pool path (/mnt/cache/... or your pool name), not /mnt/user. /mnt/user goes through Unraid's FUSE layer, which is slow for this workload and risky for SQLite.

Config.Name: Hot path (optional)
Config.Description: Planned, not used yet. Optional. Indexes and hot columns. Must be on an SSD or NVMe pool. Leave empty to keep everything under Data.

Config.Name: Cold path (optional)
Config.Description: Planned, not used yet. Optional. File-tree blobs and the optional raw archive. Written continuously as torrents arrive, so on the parity array it keeps disks spinning and slows writes. Keep it on the cache pool unless you have a reason.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for log timestamps, for example Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Intensity
Config.Description: How hard the crawler works: low, balanced or aggressive. Balanced opens about 400 metadata connections at once. Aggressive opens about 1000, and some home routers cannot track that many.

Config.Name: DHT port
Config.Description: UDP port Lodestar listens on inside the VPN tunnel. If your provider forwards a different port, set it here and forward the same number in gluetun (FIREWALL_VPN_INPUT_PORTS).
